dvids.title: CENTCOM Launches First-Ever Multinational Attack Drone Task Force
dvids.desc: TAMPA, Fla. — On Aug. 13, U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) announced efforts to establish the first-ever multi-domain, multinational attack drone task force.

dvids.title: Lt. Cmdr. Guaigua Interview-CTF 68
dvids.desc: U.S. Navy Lt. Cmdr. Mike Guaigua, future operations officer of Commander, Task Force 68 (CTF 68), discusses CTF 68's mission during a video interview on Camp Mitchell at Naval Station Rota, Spain, Aug. 13, 2026. CTF 68 is a part of the U.S. 6th Fleet and commands all Naval Expeditionary Combat Force
